fact.subject: Waymo
fact.object: Uber Austin and Atlanta robotaxi arrangement

evidence.quote:
Waymo will end its exclusivity with Uber in the Austin and Atlanta markets starting in January 2028, co-CEO Tekedra Mawakana told Bloomberg News in a
report
published Wednesday.
The robotaxi company will offer rides directly through its own smartphone app, like it does in other cities.
Uber confirmed to TechCrunch Wednesday that it still plans to host Waymo robotaxis on its app for as long as the two companies agree.

title: Waymo confirms it’s shaking up its Uber relationship in January 2028
displayTitle: Waymo与Uber在奥斯汀和亚特兰大的独家安排将于2028年结束
summary: TechCrunch根据Waymo联席CEO对彭博的表述报道，Waymo从2028年1月起结束奥斯汀和亚特兰大的Uber独家安排，并计划通过自有App接单；Uber仍可保留Waymo车辆入口。
investorNote: 这一调整把Waymo从Uber单一渠道转向双渠道分发；实际订单迁移和车队运营分工仍须观察，不能理解成两家公司立即全面分手。
narrative: Waymo联席CEO向彭博表示，奥斯汀和亚特兰大两地与Uber的**独家安排将在2028年1月结束**，Waymo届时计划像其他城市一样通过自有App提供行程。TechCrunch又从Uber确认，双方同意的情况下Uber应用仍可展示Waymo车辆。这是渠道控制权的调整，并非立即终止合作；若Waymo能直接掌握用户关系，Uber在机器人出租车流量入口上的议价位置会受到检验。

eventRelation.reason: 当日独立动作；与近两周已存事件的具体发生不同
